def generate_palindrome(min_length=255):
    # Start with the base part of the palindrome
    base = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    
    # Ensure the base length is even for perfect symmetry
    if len(base) % 2 != 0:
        base += base[-1]
    
    # Calculate half the minimum length (rounded up)
    half_length = (min_length + 1) // 2
    
    # Create the palindrome by concatenating the first half, middle character (if odd), and reversed first half
    if min_length % 2 == 0:
        palindrome = base[:half_length] + base[half_length-1::-1]
    else:
        palindrome = base[:half_length] + base[half_length] + base[half_length-1::-1]
    
    return palindrome
